_note: Series and recurring devices per brand, from research/<brand>/concepts.md ('Series and recurring devices') and extras.json. Cult.fit from the 60-ad concepts.md (25 Nov 2026), Fitelo from its 34 written-up ads. Library ids, all ads listed (extras.json lists three examples each). compute.py reads this with --series.

A.name: Fitstart Days sale card
A.note: A silent six-second astronaut and rupee coin card, "India's biggest fitness sale", carries all nine sale ads, all started 16 or 17 November; the starting price changes between ₹1,104, ₹1,145 and ₹1,162.

A.name: One film, a new centre and price each time
A.note: The "don't go to the gym" film, the gym tour and the break-up gag are re-sent with "Start your fitness journey at Cult <place>" in the text and, on the first two, a new price on the end card. Seven places in 11 ads, all started 13 October to 16 November.

A.name: Break-up gag, same answer each time
A.note: One man reacts to four life events and says "chalo cult chalte hai" each time; the same clip runs in six ads, four under different centres and two September "For Every Moment" ads that name no centre.

A.name: Many formats, never bored
A.note: Five films, each with its own script, sell class variety as the cure for a boring routine: a man explaining three formats (3 ads), a train-anywhere voiceover (4), a workout-picker teaser (10), a first-timer mother (1) and a man who changed the room (1). All go to the app link.

B.name: Customer story, same cashback end card
B.note: Ten customer-story videos hand over to the same man in a Fitelo polo pointing at "Lose weight, win 10X cashback" and "first 100 customers only"; the ads do not name him.

B.name: Cashback cheque prop
B.note: A collage of cheques stamped "100 % CASHBACK OFFER" (about ₹4,250 to ₹16,000) in eight videos, while the voice in all but one promises 10X.

B.name: Smart scale at ₹999
B.note: Five ideas sell the same scale; four say ₹999 against ₹4,999 or ₹5,000 with a free dietitian call, and "this week", "3 days" or "Only 50 Scales Left"; one image shows no price.

B.name: Named customer with a starting weight
B.note: A full-length photo with name, town and start weight and no after weight; two end on the identical "up to 30% off" card.
